scope: Final Gate A garden, house, approach and burrow captures; automated continuous recording

defects.observation: Old Burrow is one sparse arena with a quiet painted floor and simple semantic wall shapes. It needs authored environmental purpose and landmarks before campaign expansion.
defects.action: Keep the encounter small for combat review; improve room storytelling after feedback.

defects.observation: Hearth House retains three prototype NPC beds alongside the new player bed. It reads as shared lodging rather than a personal cottage.
defects.action: Reauthor NPC home locations and the house interior together in a later content pass; preserve explicit bed ownership.

defects.observation: Player walking has four directions and four poses. Sword and dodge use derived presentation and existing poses rather than authored body action clips. Mara uses one static pose.
defects.action: Judge input timing and readability first; add action poses if that is the limiting factor.

defects.observation: Riverwood has a soft painted bank and wooden crossing, but the river remains a straight passive strip. Paths lack local wear and the bridge is a flat deck.
defects.action: Refine shoreline shape and bridge depth within authored collision after the opening playtest.

defects.observation: Amber jump markers are readable, but inherited round sparkles sometimes overlap the slime and its health bar. Sword feedback needs a human feel check.
defects.action: Primary next pressure: fresh-player combat timing, threat reading and defensive feedback.

defects.observation: Door thresholds remain simple warm analytic markers. Closed roads announce their unfinished state when targeted. Discoverability away from prompts has not been tested with a fresh player.
defects.action: Observe a fresh player without coaching before adding more hints.

defects.observation: One slime, two plots, one meal and six starter seeds prove the loop but do not establish ten to twenty minutes of engaging first-play duration. Tone audio and the short repeating melody remain provisional.
defects.action: Measure human duration and motivation; expand or refine only this loop before Gate B.

primaryNextPressure: Fresh-player combat feel and comprehension within the opening loop
